Plot a statnnet network with statistical annotations

Source: R/plot-network.R
plot_network.Rd

Draws the supported single-hidden-layer network. Input-to-hidden edges can be annotated with individual-weight estimates or Wald p-values. Individual weight results are diagnostics; grouped results from anova.statnnet() are the intended covariate-level summaries.

Usage

plot_network(
  x,
  annotate = c("estimate", "p_value", "none"),
  alpha = 0.05,
  digits = 3L,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A statnnet object.

annotate

One of "estimate", "p_value", or "none".

alpha

Significance threshold used to colour p-value annotations.

digits

Number of annotation digits.

...

Additional graphical parameters passed to graphics::plot().

Value

Edge information, invisibly.

Examples

data("auto_mpg", package = "statnnet")
example_data <- auto_mpg
example_data$mpg <- as.numeric(scale(example_data$mpg))
example_data$weight <- as.numeric(scale(example_data$weight))
set.seed(3)
fit <- nnet::nnet(
  mpg ~ weight + origin,
  data = example_data,
  size = 1,
  linout = TRUE,
  decay = 0.1,
  Hess = TRUE,
  maxit = 500,
  trace = FALSE
)
model <- statnnet(fit, data = example_data, response = "continuous")
plot_network(model, annotate = "none")
